table.name: audit_change
table.remarks: Append-only per-row audit change with JSONB snapshot. No FK on entity_id (polymorphic audit).

column.name: previous_values
column.remarks: Full snapshot before mutation as JSONB

column.name: current_values
column.remarks: Full snapshot after mutation as JSONB

table.name: audit_event
table.remarks: Immutable audit event grouping one temporal mutation operation.

column.name: action
column.remarks: CREATE, UPDATE, SOFT_DELETE, DELETE

column.name: correlation_id
column.remarks: B3 trace correlation ID captured via app.correlation_id GUC; NULL when unset.

table.name: block
table.remarks: Submission block belonging to a reporting unit.

column.name: deleted
column.remarks: Soft-delete flag; live uniqueness indexes exclude deleted rows.

table.name: block_area_segment
table.remarks: Area and road segments used by a submission block.

column.name: block_mark_id
column.remarks: Optional mark associated with this area segment.

column.name: starting_area_ha
column.remarks: Starting area for the segment, in hectares.

column.name: net_waste_area_ha
column.remarks: Calculated net waste area for the segment, in hectares.

table.name: block_attachment
table.remarks: Evidence attachment metadata; object content is stored outside PostgreSQL.

table.name: block_calculation_snapshot
table.remarks: Append-only calculation inputs and outputs pinned to a district-volume configuration.

column.name: calculated_at
column.remarks: Timestamp at which the calculation snapshot was produced.

column.name: rounding_policy
column.remarks: Rounding policy used to produce the snapshot outputs.

column.name: warnings
column.remarks: Non-fatal warnings produced during calculation.

table.name: block_comment
table.remarks: Submission block comments, including status-event context.

table.name: block_mark
table.remarks: Typed forest and road marks associated with a submission block.

column.name: forest_file_id
column.remarks: Forest file identifier associated with the mark.

column.name: timber_mark
column.remarks: Timber mark identifier.

column.name: cutting_permit_id
column.remarks: Cutting permit identifier.

column.name: cut_block_id
column.remarks: Cut block identifier.

table.name: block_requirement
table.remarks: Requirement responses and optional evidence links for a submission block.

column.name: first_name
column.remarks: Sponsor first name.

column.name: last_name
column.remarks: Sponsor last name.

column.name: designation
column.remarks: Sponsor professional designation.

column.name: licence_no
column.remarks: Sponsor licence number.

column.name: email
column.remarks: Sponsor email address.

column.name: phone
column.remarks: Sponsor phone number.

column.name: first_name
column.remarks: Submitter first name.

column.name: last_name
column.remarks: Submitter last name.

column.name: designation
column.remarks: Submitter professional designation.

column.name: licence_no
column.remarks: Submitter licence number.

column.name: email
column.remarks: Submitter email address.

column.name: phone
column.remarks: Submitter phone number.

table.name: district_average_block
table.remarks: District Average-specific block extension.

column.name: coast_ground_based_area_ha
column.remarks: Coast ground-based logging area, in hectares; exposed as groundBasedAreaHa for Coast blocks.

column.name: harvest_status_code
column.remarks: Harvest status code supplied for the submission block.

column.name: bec_zone
column.remarks: Biogeoclimatic ecosystem classification zone for Interior blocks.

column.name: bec_subvariant
column.remarks: Biogeoclimatic ecosystem classification subvariant for Interior blocks.

column.name: has_dispersed_retention
column.remarks: Whether dispersed retention applies to the submission block.

column.name: dispersed_retention_pct
column.remarks: Dispersed retention percentage when dispersed retention applies.

column.name: primary_logging_complete_date
column.remarks: Date primary logging was completed.

column.name: heli_logging
column.remarks: Whether helicopter logging applies to the submission block.

column.name: cable_yarding_area_ha
column.remarks: Area harvested using cable yarding, in hectares.

column.name: skyline_logging_area_ha
column.remarks: Area harvested using skyline logging, in hectares.

table.name: district_volume
table.remarks: This table stores district waste volume data used to estimate waste volume on blocks.

column.name: area
column.remarks: Geographic area associated with the waste policy used for calculating district volume averages. Currently, two areas are supported: INTERIOR (North Interior and South Interior) and COASTAL (Coast).

column.name: start_date
column.remarks: The date from which this district volume record is used to calculate waste volume for blocks submitted on or after this date.

column.name: end_date
column.remarks: The end date until which this district volume record is used to calculate waste volume for blocks.

column.name: date_of_upload
column.remarks: The timestamp when the spreadsheet file (CSV or Excel) was uploaded.

column.name: table_data
column.remarks: JSON representation of the spreadsheet data uploaded by the user (CSV or Excel).

column.name: table_level_factor
column.remarks: Weighted average of district volumes. Applies to both INTERIOR and COASTAL areas.

column.name: heli_multiplier
column.remarks: A multiplier factor used to calculate waste volume for helicopter-harvested cut blocks. This currently applies to COASTAL areas only, but it is expected to be applied to INTERIOR areas in the future. For now, the INTERIOR multiplier is set to 1.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: The timestamp when the record was created.

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: The user or service account that created the record.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: The timestamp when the record was last updated.

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: The user or service account that last updated the record.

column.name: deleted
column.remarks: Whether the configuration row is soft-deleted; live queries must filter deleted = FALSE.

table.name: district_volume_formula
table.remarks: Administrator-managed formula definitions associated with a district-volume version.

column.name: formula_key
column.remarks: Stable namespaced formula identifier, such as config.*, submission.*, species.*, or hbs.*.

column.name: declared_variables
column.remarks: JSON object containing the variables declared by the formula.

column.name: validation_errors
column.remarks: JSON array of formula validation errors; an empty array means no recorded errors.

table.name: idempotency_record
table.remarks: Request fingerprints and completed responses used to make retried commands idempotent.

column.name: request_fingerprint
column.remarks: Digest of the request payload and operation contract.

column.name: status
column.remarks: Request lifecycle state: IN_PROGRESS while the mutation is executing, or COMPLETED when its response is stored.

column.name: response_status
column.remarks: HTTP status code stored with the completed response snapshot for exact retry replay.

column.name: response_snapshot
column.remarks: JSONB representation of the completed response returned for exact retry replay.

table.name: lifecycle_setting
table.remarks: Configurable lifecycle timing values stored as key/value settings.

table.name: outbox_event
table.remarks: Transactional outbox events pending reliable delivery and reconciliation.

column.name: event_id
column.remarks: Stable UUID used to identify this event across delivery attempts.

column.name: status
column.remarks: Delivery state: PENDING, IN_FLIGHT, RETRYING, CONFIRMED, RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, or PERMANENT_FAILURE.

column.name: attempt_history
column.remarks: JSONB array containing the timestamp, outcome, and error summary for each delivery attempt.

column.name: next_retry_at
column.remarks: Earliest time at which a pending or retrying event may be leased.

column.name: locked_until
column.remarks: End of the current relay lease; an expired lease may be acquired by another worker.

column.name: locked_by
column.remarks: Identifier of the relay worker holding the current lease.

checkConstraint.constraint: ((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'IN_FLIGHT'::character varying, 'RETRYING'::character varying, 'CONFIRMED'::character varying, 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'::character varying, 'PERMANENT_FAILURE'::character varying])::text[]))
checkConstraint.name: outbox_event_status_ck

table.name: reporting_unit
table.remarks: Locally-owned reporting unit for a District Average submission.

column.name: deleted
column.remarks: Soft-delete flag; live uniqueness indexes exclude deleted rows.

table.name: status_event
table.remarks: Append-only lifecycle events for reporting units and blocks.

column.name: reporting_unit_id
column.remarks: Set for a reporting-unit event; exactly one status-event subject is required.

column.name: block_id
column.remarks: Set for a block event; exactly one status-event subject is required.

column.name: status
column.remarks: Service-validated lifecycle status; no database vocabulary check is imposed yet.

checkConstraint.constraint: ((reporting_unit_id IS NOT NULL) <> (block_id IS NOT NULL))
checkConstraint.name: status_event_subject_ck

table.name: user_bookmarks
table.remarks: Table to store user bookmarked reporting units. Users can bookmark multiple reporting units. Each reporting unit can be bookmarked by multiple users. Bookmarked reporting units are also used as reference for the offline mode.

column.name: user_id
column.remarks: Unique identifier for the user

column.name: reporting_unit_id
column.remarks: Unique identifier for the reporting unit that the user has bookmarked. This is a foreign key referencing the reporting unit in the oracle database.

table.name: user_identity
table.remarks: Cached Cognito user identity attributes, used to avoid repeated userInfo calls

column.name: sub
column.remarks: Cognito subject identifier — unique, immutable UUID for the user

column.name: email
column.remarks: User email address as returned by Cognito userInfo

column.name: name
column.remarks: User full display name as returned by Cognito userInfo

column.name: given_name
column.remarks: User given (first) name as returned by Cognito userInfo

column.name: family_name
column.remarks: User family (last) name as returned by Cognito userInfo

column.name: idp_name
column.remarks: Identity provider name from custom:idp_name (e.g. idir, bceidbusiness)

column.name: idp_user_id
column.remarks: User identifier within the identity provider from custom:idp_user_id

column.name: idp_username
column.remarks: Username within the identity provider from custom:idp_username

column.name: idp_display_name
column.remarks: Display name from the identity provider from custom:idp_display_name

column.name: idp_business_id
column.remarks: BCeID business identifier from custom:idp_business_id; null for IDIR users

column.name: raw_attributes
column.remarks: Full raw attribute map returned by Cognito userInfo, stored for future use

column.name: last_synced_at
column.remarks: Timestamp of the last successful sync with Cognito; used for staleness checks

table.name: user_preferences
table.remarks: Table to store user preferences in JSON format

column.name: user_id
column.remarks: Unique identifier for the user

column.name: preferences
column.remarks: User preferences stored in JSON format

column.name: updated_date
column.remarks: Timestamp of the last update to the user preferences

column.name: revision
column.remarks: Revision number for optimistic locking

routine.name: audit_district_volume_change()
routine.comment: Writes complete OLD and NEW row-image audit records for all district_volume mutations. The actor comes from row audit columns and falls back to session_user (current_user inside SECURITY DEFINER resolves to the function owner, not the caller). The correlation_id comes from current_setting('app.correlation_id', true) and is NULL when unset.

routine.name: audit_row_change()
routine.comment: Writes one generic full-row audit event/change pair per row mutation. Entity type is the table name; soft deletion is identified from deleted=false to deleted=true.
